definitions.explanation: A chaotic fight involving multiple people, with no rules or order. Used for physical altercations in real life, sports, and also in gaming contexts.

examples.japanese: {試合後|しあいご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乱闘|らんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A brawl broke out after the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酔|よ}った→酔う：14437_you⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乱闘|らんとう}⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけた→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{乱闘|らんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すでに⟦{収|おさ}まっていた→収まる：11858_osamaru⟧。
examples.english: By the time the police arrived, the brawl had already subsided.

notes:
A disorderly, chaotic fight involving multiple people. Stronger and more violent than ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧ (quarrel/fight), and implies a lack of order or rules.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乱闘|らんとう}⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧: brawl; ruckus involving fighting
- {乱闘|らんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a brawl breaks out
- {乱闘|らんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to get caught up in a brawl
- {乱闘|らんとう}⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧: dramatic brawl; wild fight scene

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧: fight, quarrel — can be verbal or physical, usually between two people
- {殴|なぐ}り{合|あ}い: fistfight — specifically punching each other
- ⟦{格闘|かくとう}→格闘：13111_kakutou⟧: combat, grappling — more organized, can be martial arts

FORMS:
{乱|らん} (disorder, chaos) + {闘|とう} (fight, battle) — a disorderly fight.
